notes.title: Upcoming content
notes.content:
Over the next few months, I plan to add additional content to the main campaign, mostly in regards to finishing the story arc of the 2nd chapter.

Another thing to note is that I'll be incorporating some fantastic music developed by none of than the fantastic students of the Australian Institute of Music!

As you may have gathered following our discord group, I'm primarily focused on our new title Dungeontop which will be available as "coming soon" right here on steam in the coming weeks. Juggling the new game and the two existing portfolio pieces as well as the birth of my second son has been a challenge, but one I have enjoyed as much as life itself!

So stay tuned and enjoy the adventure!

notes.title: Initial release! Now what is to come?
notes.content:
First off what a journey it's been to get to this point! Thank you to all our contributors on the discord channel and our lovely testers for your time patience and love!

A couple of early folks are already asking questions and over the next few weeks this is our game plan:

1) Answer as many questions raised in the discussion forum or in discord and address any initial concerns in the game.

2) We are working on the next update which involves Mercenaries! Hired hands to help round out your deck and give you more flexibility. Look out for them in their own shops scattered throughout Port Haven.

Stay tuned for more announcements and meanwhile, enjoy the experience!
